title: Profitable OEM instrument maker, temporary dip, leverage 2.1x, family stake 31%

input.facts: Designs and builds analyzer systems sold under its customers brands (OEM) with multi-year supply contracts. Consumables and service are 62% of sales. The share price fell 38% over twelve months after the launch of the new analyzer platform slipped by two quarters; the H1 release shows order intake recovering and the first platform shipments done. The founding family holds 31% and has made no public statement about its stake. No regulatory matters reported.

why: In segment, recurring model, temporary reason for the drop, leverage well below 4x, no kill criterion. The family stake is a flag to report, not a reject.
